finding: The press highlight used to disappear on finger-up while the single-tap recognizer still awaited double-tap failure. In the unchanged0260 native recording, the cell loses its highlight at sampled5.150s and remains plain at5.450s, before an X stroke at5.525s. The functional result was already correct; this is an acknowledgement gap.
changes: Transfer a valid short contact into a lighter static pending outline while the existing recognizer ledger is busy. Keep the old X or empty cell underneath; no provisional marks, sounds, scoring, life changes or timer.

Separate normal pan touch-end from cancellation/reset. Early pan reset does not retire a transferred pending tap. Single/double acceptance clears only its target; a new contact or recognized pan removes the previous pending decoration.

Input completion, out-of-board movement, cancellation, cover/preview/lock, background, hidden/detached view, session replacement and geometry changes clear the outline. Existing three recognizers, double-tap precedence, thresholds and business commit times are unchanged.

verificationHistory.scope: Unchanged0260 production plus the same new real-native UI test. One functional test passed; visual gap was confirmed from recording, not represented as a failed functional assertion.

testedScope: Four new App tests: pending add/undo normal and reduced motion without early state writes; second contact/double outcome; prior-cell completion while another contact waits; cancellation, pan end, outside, lock, hidden, effects-off, preview, background, replacement, resize, detach, all-recognizers-finished and missing-active-attempt cases.
Existing cell feedback, guidance, input ownership, particle lifecycle, individual score receipt and actual full-level victory→next-board tests ran;65 total passed, no skips.

Four17e native UI tests: new short press/add/undo/double/hint; tutorial skip/double no leaked X; tap/double/horizontal/vertical/diagonal/outside then tools; mixed consecutive gestures without repeated damage/score.
